speaker: Doctor
text: I need to ask a few questions to narrow this down. When did the bilious vomiting start, and was there any passage of meconium? Also, have you noticed any abdominal distension or color changes on your baby's skin?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Volvulus (suggested by bilious vomiting in a newborn without meconium passage, despite family history of pyloric stenosis). Immediate surgical evaluation is required.
